Peter, This letter couldn't wait.That's why Kirk Cameron personally asked me to write you on the post-production budget shortfall for "Iggy and Mr. Kirk." He wanted to make sure you heard about this urgent situation as soon as possible.**And after you hear what's going on, I hope you'll support BRAVE FOR GOOD.** **[We are facing a serious budget shortfall of $48,523.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c0ddf817f4664fcb8c78f6ab2869e400&_e=33LOccY-1pwSQvLk9XC1WSZEr7V4lTS51yl-lnY8uixsdQfEEJmW-wLR8aYALPaICAXWzEyMUEJsyw9nDkJmf8jW5-1u_7PfBuplNKAX8YkfVI9S6kCtUnyMxZoJZRuIM8BcbyD_jwJLSFHTtDntEL5Fk3phr0Xspe1h-wDFdM4_88tcOSfeG7WfHN7tVqfFa7YbafopO_UeGk-GTIG4HfV7P67NXejHci7syTQBuFASF1XhoCt7pStHK5eU_MzzyRADuhGqAJhZ79Z15e26B30SE1HOdhk6E9w3CEA0kOUvCeh04SjlNeMkRES9Jnuugvc5gXBkiz_FteqNHeBCJsTAKt_3xSfIZM1jjSzWhRM_Euiw2-fiFGhOeh-5aG2S6dmcpz9ApTHOBlkk_hRE5Zc7nXabs4EEtEajYG1t-W43YY9glfrLaONYOKT2iOdRRTM6beEfZ5yteKNUcysQa87rkbjCaPYO1l2zvUGG8rwFKIKbdpE6WPhYkd_9cO0JV4IdMo8GUOapmzApcV8_2A%3D%3D)** But before I go into more detail, let me tell you a little about our mission to help parents instill wholesome and Godly values in America's children. Kirk just wrapped up this year's "See You at the Library Day," where we countered the Left and brought conservative values straight to America's children.Kirk is busy spearheading the "Bible Revival" movement that gSUPERLIST Biblical values -- that America was founded upon -- back into schools. And Kirk just finished filming Season 3 of our television show "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" that teaches children how to respond to the deceitful culture with Biblical values and steadfast faith.**I'm writing you with such urgency because Season 3 of "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" is in jeopardy.** **[And if I can't raise $48,523 in the next four weeks, "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" will be delayed -- or even postponed indefinitely.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c0ddf817f4664fcb8c78f6ab2869e400&_e=33LOccY-1pwSQvLk9XC1WSZEr7V4lTS51yl-lnY8uixsdQfEEJmW-wLR8aYALPaICAXWzEyMUEJsyw9nDkJmf8jW5-1u_7PfBuplNKAX8YkfVI9S6kCtUnyMxZoJZRuIM8BcbyD_jwJLSFHTtDntEL5Fk3phr0Xspe1h-wDFdM4_88tcOSfeG7WfHN7tVqfFa7YbafopO_UeGk-GTIG4HfV7P67NXejHci7syTQBuFASF1XhoCt7pStHK5eU_MzzyRADuhGqAJhZ79Z15e26B30SE1HOdhk6E9w3CEA0kOUvCeh04SjlNeMkRES9Jnuugvc5gXBkiz_FteqNHeBCJsTAKt_3xSfIZM1jjSzWhRPEmN3jEe0hZdzGMcO3k9wBm_u4zAmF1g0DpdiBkPxW7duN_ktXRWCzh2GSInPjk7mDleiotInWRT60A0TCc50WMh1iMsjZj_7JB08xuDtsAkW0yrs3EC0BWQceZOpxk0A-132Ry0Gpzt-yVDvL9IR-Ss_jBC_SOSDa6_kqCw89Ug%3D%3D)** The radical Leftists who attack us because we're reaching America's children with God's Truth would love nothing more than to see "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" shut down.They hate that "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" has skyrocketed to the top of Angel Studios' streaming service. They hate that we've created a path around the addictive mind rot they put on TV.It's like Kirk always says... It's not enough to complain about culture raising our children. We must create something better for them. The first 2 seasons of "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" have reached millions of children and counting, but Season 3 is in jeopardy.If "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" isn't funded, there will be no voice on TV countering the Left's dangerous lies.Lies like Drag Queens leading a Pride Parade SingAlong on Blue's Clues...Same-sex weddings on Arthur... And Sesame Street using YOUR tax dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And that's just what's on TV. Not to mention the thousands of 'Queer Kid' videos on platforms like YouTube Kids.The days of The Andy Griffith Show and Father Knows Best are gone. The Left has purposely used TV to create a generation of zombie children who are glued to their screens."Iggy and Mr. Kirk" is the antidote to that Leftist TV brainwashing.It uses low-stimulation production and teaches children how to respond to the deceitful culture with Biblical values and steadfast faith. Like when Mr. Kirk teaches Iggy:

* to love how God created him as an iguana, even when the villainous Culture the Vulture says Iggy must become a human to fit in.
* to rely on the wisdom of parents -- one mom and one dad -- to solve life's problems.

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: President AOC? It's not a joke anymore.
body:
Plus: New Mexico Democrats hit the supermajority | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/TRqbC8Us_CC?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
Last Tuesday was brutal. No way around it.
[So this week I brought in Republican pollster Jeff Glassburner to tell us what actually happened.](https://us.list-manage.com/BCFGSfwBaOn?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) Independents didn’t just lean left, they voted like Democrats. New Mexico now has a 47-23 supermajority in the House. And the Senate isn’t coming back for a while.
Then I asked Jeff which Democrat worries him most in 2028. He said AOC
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/4IPkUhMi4Jx?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
**🔥 INDEPENDENTS DIDN’T LEAN DEMOCRAT. THEY VOTED LIKE DEMOCRATS.**
Pollsters nailed where Republicans would land. Then the undecideds broke 30, 40, 50 points the other way, depending on the state. Jeff says independents haven’t voted as one bloc like this since Watergate.
This was not a turnout collapse. Jeff explains what it was instead, and why that’s harder to fix.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/160vXVxZeQH?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**🚨 JD VANCE SAYS IT WAS IRAN. JEFF SAYS LOOK AT LAST YEAR.**
The vice president blamed the war this week. Jeff points to two governor’s races a full year ago that showed the same number everyone’s shocked by now.
Republicans lost Mississippi, Kansas and Texas on the same night. Jeff has one line about what that means for the party that I couldn’t argue with either.

**🏛️ DEMOCRATS NOW HAVE A SUPERMAJORITY IN SANTA FE.**
Rebecca Dow is out. Luis Terrazas is out. Democrats hold exactly two-thirds of the New Mexico House.
I pulled Eddy, Lea and Chaves County turnout and compared it to 2022. The population went up. Republican turnout went the other way.
There’s also a registration number that changes how we look at 2030.

**⚠️ PRESIDENT AOC. IT’S NO JOKE.**
Jeff says Republicans are underestimating AOC “to an extreme degree.” She’s going to own the rooms in Iowa, South Carolina and Nevada, and the center of the Democratic Party has nobody left who can box her out the way Biden boxed out Bernie.
Then we walk through the 2028 Senate map. Six seats, none of them deep red, and a road back that probably runs through 2030.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/B_rZB4AuTV5?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**PLUS:** Why Trump “likes it when his proteges fight,” 65 House seats in play for 2028, Jeff’s three-word advice for the White House, and the prediction bet Krysty lost. Ella may not get dinner this week.

body:
Wow! I cannot believe it. The race has been called: We have won and defeated Lauren Boebert! And we did it together.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143190829/659424844/944052890?refcode=20261109-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTgxNzIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjIxNmYzY2MtYjJkYy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhMWI4OTYyIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=yl_QdodmfVIKoh_K9v8ZBkQ_F7I-wkC5q4er5kyD2_Q=&emci=8093c516-b2dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&emdi=f216f3cc-b2dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&ceid=19917364)

Wow! I cannot believe it. **The race has been called: We have won and defeated Lauren Boebert! And we did it _together_.**
Thirty-four years ago, I raised my right hand and took an oath to support and defend the Constitution of the United States. That oath shaped the course of my life. It took me around the world, introduced me to extraordinary people, and taught me what it truly means to serve something greater than myself.
And through it all, one belief grew stronger and stronger: **This country, its people, and the ideals we stand for will always be worth fighting for.**
When we started this campaign, a lot of people told us this couldn't be done. They told us this district was too Republican. That the political divisions were too deep. That people had already made up their minds.
But you and I believed something different. We believed that if you showed up, if you listened, and if you treated people with respect, you might discover that we have a lot more in common than Washington would have us believe. And that's exactly what happened.
I drove over 40,000 miles across all 21 counties of this district. I met Republicans who were frustrated. Independents who felt forgotten. Democrats who were ready to get to work. And I met a whole lot of people who were simply tired. Tired of the fighting. Tired of the distractions. Tired of watching politicians make everything about themselves while the problems facing their families went unsolved.
They weren't asking for miracles. They were asking for someone to do the job.
Colorado’s 4th congressional district has sent a message. That public service is a responsibility, not a privilege. That leadership is about what you do for other people, not what you can do for yourself. And that we do not have to accept division and dysfunction as the price of living in this country. We can expect more from the people we send to Washington. And we should.
**This was only possible because of _you_.** People who took time away from their families. Who knocked on doors in the heat and the cold. Who made one more phone call when they were exhausted. Who chipped in five or ten dollars even when times were tough. Thank you. From the bottom of my heart. Thank you.
This is not about me or Lauren Boebert. It is, and always has been, about the people of Colorado’s 4th congressional district. They are who I thought about every single day of this campaign. And they are who I am going to fight for every day in Washington.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for trusting me. Thank you for believing that we can do things differently. And thank you for giving me one more opportunity to serve the country I love.
**Now it's time to get to work.** The problems facing American families haven’t changed. Grocery prices are still too high, healthcare remains unaffordable for too many, and the war in Iran continues. Those challenges remain, and the work starts now.
Thank you,
Eileen

##### _**-- Cliff**_
## **First: YOU**
Incredible. Generational. Seismic.
That's what last Tuesday was and has been every day since, as we count votes and win more seats. NBC keeps inching up. Now they're saying 259 House seats. They know they wanna get to that 260 I predicted--c'mon NBC, you can do it, you totally wanna!
**Ok, now on a serious note:** **YOU made it happen.**
**You** , the incredible members of our community who donated that extra dollar. **You** , who knocked on that last half-block of doors when your feet felt anvils. **You** , who made that last few calls when you needed clothes pins to keep your eyes open.
And yes, **you** , who ensured your teenager, or that co-worker who _always_ works late, got to the polls. **Because you knew how important this election was.**
_Tsunami doesn 't quite do justice to what you did. It was more like the meteor that would make a velociraptor more than a bit nervous._
We came close to sweeping just about every damn thing we could, including Don Jr.'s cocai..I mean sugar spilled on the floor. Yeah, sugar... We won almost everything we conceivably could.
**You** made it happen.
We took back entire swing states, cemented others as blue. We elected the first Black female governor of any state in Georgia. Deb Haaland became the first Native American woman elected governor of a state in New Mexico. (some more stories like this below).
**You** made it happen.
We ousted some of the worst, most entrenched incumbents, from Gov. Greg Abbott in Texas to Sen. Susan Collins in Maine to Rep. Ann Wagner in Missouri, whose 14-yr right-wing Cruella de Vil reign was ended by my good pal Fred Wellman (Go Fred!).
**You** made it happen
And you didn't just elect Democrats in big ticket races. State legislators, attorneys general--who can prosecute federal officials, say ICE, for breaking state law. Secretaries of state to ensure all the votes in 2028 are counted. **This community played an enormous role in electing them all**. So I hope **you** know it. I hope **you** can take a look in the mirror, reflect, and be proud of all **you** did. **You** saved our ailing democracy from authoritarianism in a bad wig. Call it the un-orange revolution.
One last time: **you** made it happen.
I can only speak for this one American. This one Ohioan. I never thank you enough for all you did to make this past week happen. I can live in a country I believe in again. One that embraced our "better angels." And I now live in state that'll never-ever-never have to say "Governor Ramaswamy." And where we won nearly every other big race.
Incredible. Generational. Seismic.
**I can never say "thank you" enough to this amazing community.**
\- Cliff

## **Four Weddings And A Funeral**
Happiness...is a warm...US Senate with 56 Democrats, and a ton of talented moderate-to--liberal governors running 29 states where 75% of the U.S. population lives. For making me feeling confident for the first time in two years we're not a just a hop, skip, and a jump from officially becoming a Vladimir Putin mistress.
Some of the specifics: we elected a cadre of talented Gen Xers and millennials who finally got their shot and came up big. Just in our thumbnail, you have Dr. Annie Andrews, elected the first woman Senator from South Carolina. Dr. Amy Acton, the first woman and Jewish person elected Governor of Ohio. Gina Hinojosa, who is the first Latina Governor of Texas, where Latinos now comprise 41% of the state's residents.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/de259af3-6826-4eae-8e91-05d610bc1d79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As Abigail Adams famously wrote to her husband John, as he was attending the Second Continental Congress in Philadelphia on March 31, 1776, "Remember the ladies." And so we have. Even when it's for slightly different reasons, because...
**Breaking News:** Lauren Boebert has officially lost her reelection! Going through her sordid history would take its own entire post and a de-lousing, so another time. But let's just say my pure-joy level has reached 11. Especially as we almost knocked her out of Congress from a lean Republican seat, so she snuck next door _to a much more solid Republican district and_ ...yeah, that didn't work this time.
Ain't that just the icing on the cake?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/de259af3-6826-4eae-8e91-05d610bc1d79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lauren Boebert, confused by decimals_
Boebert will now have the free time to attend all the Beetlejuice productions her little heart--and roaming hands--desire(s). Seriously, of all the embarrassments, she's been one of the been one of the worst. Trashier than a night out with Kid Rock, George Santos, and a bag of crystal meth come to life.
Buh bye now Lauren. We hardly--but way too f*king well--knew ya.

* * *
## Reconstruction Done Right
And now that we've covered the ladies, let's not forget what Scott Colom is about to do in Mississippi. First of all, change the whole damn state. Some of us (see: me) have been obsessed with turning The Magnolia State into a swing state for a while. It lacks the profile of a normal swing state--white, liberal Northeast and California retirees moving there, huge Latino/a population. Suburbs exponentially growing.
But it has something no other state can come close to: you start off with a 38% Black population. Think of that base right there. When other minority groups are added in--ones that don't vote Democratic in quite as high percents, but still strongly--you clear 40%. At that point, win your college kids, win bigger in the suburbs of cities like Memphis, don't lose the rural white vote by quite as large a margin, and turn out your base(!), and you're there. This may help tell the story:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/de259af3-6826-4eae-8e91-05d610bc1d79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So along came senate candidate Scott Colom, with his prosecutor's record, his charming demeanor, and brilliantly produced digital ads. Kaboom.
Colom, if we continue to fund him so he can pay staff, for food, the office...the little things as they're counting all the votes, **will win**. **([donate to Scott Colum here!](https://substack.com/redirect/353b24bd-7e77-4782-bd6e-4bea61262283?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) **Provisional ballots go our way by definition, because they're cast by those right-wing thugs try to disenfranchise by sending to the wrong polling places, etc.
So we'll have Mississippi's first Black senator since Reconstruction. Think about that for a second. And want some beautiful irony? He already flipped Forrest County, MS, named for lug-headed, robo-racist, Nathan Bedford Forrest, Civil War Confederate general and the first Grand Wizard of the original, Reconstruction-era, league of unbelievable assholes, the Ku Klux Klan.
So, yeah, Colom won your county! 😀 😃 😁
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=224237003&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjI0MjM3MDAzLCJpYXQiOjE3OTQyODAyNTQsImV4cCI6MTc5Njg3MjI1NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.qI2inOweZrjHQcTmz2cKa_-O2XRS4sSXtSaDPu-F1UU&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
* * *
## Dropping Out And Still Beating A Republican
It would seem you didn't even have to actually run for office to beat Republicans this midterm. Which, if we're being honest, is the way it _always_ should be.
For those who didn't think you could be any happier with what happened Tuesday. Au contraire. This will do it:
> Voters still questioning the scale of Tuesday's 'blue wave' midterm elections should look to Iowa, where a Democratic candidate who suspended his campaign nearly two months ago swept to victory over his Republican challenger.
> Democrat Eric Armstrong on Thursday said he was 'proud to announce that we won Iowa House District 20,' adding that voters 'sent a clear message about the direction they want for Iowa, and I will make sure that message is carried to the Capitol in January.'
> A retired railroad executive, Armstrong won with about 55% of the vote―or about 9 percent―over his GOP opponent, former police lieutenant Keith Jones, who secured about 45%.
> To those familiar with the race, the victory came as a bit of a surprise, given that Armstrong had formally suspended his campaign Sept. 7, citing 'some personal health issues that require my full attention and immediate care.'
And that just feels like a great one to end on.
**We will have more stories to share. Because there are so many. So get ready for a whole lot of good news, and not just the doom and gloom we have had to live with.**
**Once again, we can never tell you how important this community is to us. Thank you for all you do!**
_**-- Cliff**_

And some of the best stories of the midterms are about the people who won (and in a few cases--lost). | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? As more votes are counted, more races are being called. And some of the best stories of the midterms are about the people who won (and in a few cases--lost). | | and | Nov 9 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Cliff 's Note: We Won. Bigly. The 50-yr storm I kept predicting landed (i.e. the biggest rout since the post-Watergate 1974 Midterm --52 yrs ago). And, oh, do we have great stories for you; one breaking, some surprises! , -- Cliff First: YOU Incredible. Generational. Seismic. That's what last Tuesday was and has been every day since, as we count votes and win more seats. NBC keeps inching up. Now they're saying 259 House seats. They know they wanna get to that 260 I predicted--c'mon NBC, you can do it, you totally wanna! Ok, now on a serious note: YOU made it happen. You , the incredible members of our community who donated that extra dollar. You , who knocked on that last half-block of doors when your feet felt anvils. You , who made that last few calls when you needed clothes pins to keep your eyes open. And yes, you , who ensured your teenager, or that co-worker who always works late, got to the polls. Because you knew how important this election was. Tsunami doesn 't quite do justice to what you did. It was more like the meteor that would make a velociraptor more than a bit nervous. We came close to sweeping just about every damn thing we could, including Don Jr.'s cocai..I mean sugar spilled on the floor. Yeah, sugar... We won almost everything we conceivably could. You made it happen. We took back entire swing states, cemented others as blue. We elected the first Black female governor of any state in Georgia. Deb Haaland became the first Native American woman elected governor of a state in New Mexico. (some more stories like this below). You made it happen. We ousted some of the worst, most entrenched incumbents, from Gov. Greg Abbott in Texas to Sen. Susan Collins in Maine to Rep. Ann Wagner in Missouri, whose 14-yr right-wing Cruella de Vil reign was ended by my good pal Fred Wellman (Go Fred!). You made it happen And you didn't just elect Democrats in big ticket races. State legislators, attorneys general--who can prosecute federal officials, say ICE, for breaking state law. Secretaries of state to ensure all the votes in 2028 are counted. This community played an enormous role in electing them all. So I hope you know it. I hope you can take a look in the mirror, reflect, and be proud of all you did. You saved our ailing democracy from authoritarianism in a bad wig. Call it the un-orange revolution. One last time: you made it happen. I can only speak for this one American. This one Ohioan. I never thank you enough for all you did to make this past week happen. I can live in a country I believe in again. One that embraced our "better angels." And I now live in state that'll never-ever-never have to say "Governor Ramaswamy." And where we won nearly every other big race. Incredible. Generational. Seismic. I can never say "thank you" enough to this amazing community. \- Cliff Four Weddings And A Funeral Happiness...is a warm...US Senate with 56 Democrats, and a ton of talented moderate-to--liberal governors running 29 states where 75% of the U.S. population lives. For making me feeling confident for the first time in two years we're not a just a hop, skip, and a jump from officially becoming a Vladimir Putin mistress. Some of the specifics: we elected a cadre of talented Gen Xers and millennials who finally got their shot and came up big. Just in our thumbnail, you have Dr. Annie Andrews, elected the first woman Senator from South Carolina. Dr. Amy Acton, the first woman and Jewish person elected Governor of Ohio. Gina Hinojosa, who is the first Latina Governor of Texas, where Latinos now comprise 41% of the state's residents. | | ---|---|--- As Abigail Adams famously wrote to her husband John, as he was attending the Second Continental Congress in Philadelphia on March 31, 1776, "Remember the ladies." And so we have. Even when it's for slightly different reasons, because... Breaking News: Lauren Boebert has officially lost her reelection! Going through her sordid history would take its own entire post and a de-lousing, so another time. But let's just say my pure-joy level has reached 11. Especially as we almost knocked her out of Congress from a lean Republican seat, so she snuck next door to a much more solid Republican district and ...yeah, that didn't work this time. Ain't that just the icing on the cake? | | ---|---|--- Lauren Boebert, confused by decimals Boebert will now have the free time to attend all the Beetlejuice productions her little heart--and roaming hands--desire(s). Seriously, of all the embarrassments, she's been one of the been one of the worst. Trashier than a night out with Kid Rock, George Santos, and a bag of crystal meth come to life. Buh bye now Lauren. We hardly--but way too fking well--knew ya. Reconstruction Done Right And now that we've covered the ladies, let's not forget what Scott Colom is about to do in Mississippi. First of all, change the whole damn state. Some of us (see: me) have been obsessed with turning The Magnolia State into a swing state for a while. It lacks the profile of a normal swing state--white, liberal Northeast and California retirees moving there, huge Latino/a population. Suburbs exponentially growing. But it has something no other state can come close to: you start off with a 38% Black population. Think of that base right there. When other minority groups are added in--ones that don't vote Democratic in quite as high percents, but still strongly--you clear 40%. At that point, win your college kids, win bigger in the suburbs of cities like Memphis, don't lose the rural white vote by quite as large a margin, and turn out your base(!), and you're there. This may help tell the story: | | ---|---|--- So along came senate candidate Scott Colom, with his prosecutor's record, his charming demeanor, and brilliantly produced digital ads. Kaboom. Colom, if we continue to fund him so he can pay staff, for food, the office...the little things as they're counting all the votes, will win. () Provisional ballots go our way by definition, because they're cast by those right-wing thugs try to disenfranchise by sending to the wrong polling places, etc. So we'll have Mississippi's first Black senator since Reconstruction. Think about that for a second. And want some beautiful irony? He already flipped Forrest County, MS, named for lug-headed, robo-racist, Nathan Bedford Forrest, Civil War Confederate general and the first Grand Wizard of the original, Reconstruction-era, league of unbelievable assholes, the Ku Klux Klan. So, yeah, Colom won your county! 😀 😃 😁 Dropping Out And Still Beating A Republican It would seem you didn't even have to actually run for office to beat Republicans this midterm. Which, if we're being honest, is the way it always should be. For those who didn't think you could be any happier with what happened Tuesday. Au contraire. This will do it: Voters still questioning the scale of Tuesday's 'blue wave' midterm elections should look to Iowa, where a Democratic candidate who suspended his campaign nearly two months ago swept to victory over his Republican challenger. Democrat Eric Armstrong on Thursday said he was 'proud to announce that we won Iowa House District 20,' adding that voters 'sent a clear message about the direction they want for Iowa, and I will make sure that message is carried to the Capitol in January.' A retired railroad executive, Armstrong won with about 55% of the vote―or about 9 percent―over his GOP opponent, former police lieutenant Keith Jones, who secured about 45%. To those familiar with the race, the victory came as a bit of a surprise, given that Armstrong had formally suspended his campaign Sept. 7, citing 'some personal health issues that require my full attention and immediate care.' And that just feels like a great one to end on. We will have more stories to share. Because there are so many. So get ready for a whole lot of good news, and not just the doom and gloom we have had to live with. Once again, we can never tell you how important this community is to us. Thank you for all you do! -- Cliff Blue Amp Media is reader-supported. To receive new posts & support our work, please become a free or paid subscriber. name: Roy Cooper
subject: Scott Colom needs our support in Mississippi
body:
Every seat matters, and we CAN flip this one.
|
#
| Peter: **The U.S. Senate race in Mississippi is still too close to call.**
---
Democrat Scott Colom is ahead of Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith by just a couple thousand votes. That’s 0.3%. More votes are coming in as we speak, but Scott’s campaign is relying on a surge of grassroots resources to keep up the fight.
**Every seat matters. We can flip this one, but only if we work together to ensure every vote is counted.[Will you split $5 between Scott and me so we can win in Mississippi and secure the most powerful Democratic Senate majority possible?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/20270?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1679&amount=5&t=7&akid=5346%2E124072%2EC6wrpo)**
Thank you,
Roy
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Scott Colom**
Date: Wed, Nov 4, 2026
Subject: This race is still too close to call

| | | | Hi, Peter – Roy Cooper here. My friend Scott Colom is running for U.S. Senate in Mississippi, and he needs our support. If you can, [**_I hope you'll split a donation between our grassroots campaigns._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/20269?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1679&amount=5&t=8&akid=5346%2E124072%2EC6wrpo)

If you'd no longer like to receive these partner emails, [**_you can opt out here._**](https://act.roycooper.com/signup/unsub-tandems/?t=9&akid=5346%2E124072%2EC6wrpo)
---|---
A handful of votes, Peter.
Right now that is all that separates me and Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi. **This race is not over.**
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/20269?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1679&amount=5&t=10&akid=5346%2E124072%2EC6wrpo)
Election Day may have passed but our work is FAR from done. We need to protect the will of the voters. [**_Can you help me by splitting $5 to my campaign and Roy Cooper now?_**
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/20270?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1679&amount=5&t=12&akid=5346%2E124072%2EC6wrpo)
---
Here’s where we’re at: Right now, this race is too close to call. Thanks to your hard work and dedication we are on track to win this race. That means we need to ensure every single eligible vote is counted. And I can tell you this for sure: Whatever the result is, the final margin here is going to be **razor thin.**
I’ll always stand up for voting rights. Today, I’m humbly asking you to stand with me and chip in whatever you can to ensure we have the resources we need.
[**_If you’re looking for some way to have an impact, please make a donation to help us flip Mississippi’s U.S. Senate seat right now._**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Scott Colom and Cooper Victory Fund will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/20271?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1679&amount=5&t=14&akid=5346%2E124072%2EC6wrpo)

I’m grateful for the trust that you and the voters of Mississippi have placed in me.
Let’s win this,
Scott Colom

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

body:
# [](https://act.janepac.com/go/30?t=1&akid=23%2E6803%2EBwrvaT)
[](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261110-23&t=3&akid=23%2E6803%2EBwrvaT)
I want to take a second to check in with the heart of our movement: **you.**
**As of this morning, we helped elect over 215 courageous climate champions to offices all across the country!** Michigan. Texas. My home state of California. Pennsylvania. Georgia. The list goes on.
These fearless leaders took on corporate polluters, shady dark money groups, and even a trillionaire named Elon Musk with millions to spend. But they didn’t back down. Not for a second.
And on Election Day, we saw victories in places where change once seemed impossible. I’ll never forget that feeling.
You helped make a better future possible, and as we look toward the next chapter of our movement, I want to hear directly from you about where we go next:
_How are you feeling after last Tuesday’s results?_
_What message resonated with you the most?_
_What moment made you feel that hope was truly possible?_

## Macrons Sue Candace Owens in Nashville
French President Emmanuel Macron and his wife, Brigitte, [filed a defamation lawsuit](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb1jwTBw8MHTxlq4drWd4jmkxjgAb9e-rpP2DjldXurrnfNymG_rg4_0dNzKlLFOkmgOVQmna0KY95oPyXinmXD4PR3d_-gkE9FxKLsWEtviTJoWNMzPIAZVtyMjroDqhBxia1XQXvcyOAHpBVs-z7WEA0p3C-UKDvTTePAellEJKoZVu-6UDK52-Ok1WoWJKkPNlT21ZqVCMlDPREr73k1Jr960JZi3lkVn3xmBkMNZa2_qV4rNkMD6pGIxhtxj4X4iY19OHQAxGi9GhJf4C5bRtGA8K_NcAr34hHrDmwxcGY5OMe1Qfgs_9lSlx39CH14vyT4WngZ8AAAD__2p2iU0) against podcaster Candace Owens in federal court in Nashville. The suit [alleges Owens repeatedly made false statements](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSnSAQRp8GOxxYUbGgSGP3p03p8MN6JUFwYK9M3j7jfYX0O_udc359bV82xJBeP-2JhmjfErYakQjLdlpXcqpvrLlhqpV-vz2-wh02EDBxKbkUm3UUbtyU7bz5BrlY5To0cl7UIPQCS3cYbQGEGmGaF_ntcYB9QC2H0Xmt3O7GLpjnoZRSSCm00v20D-Ck17PX6JRVTAn0gXLp6UDClLBWxD3-zTeW3uWzi-YguiobfjBYGayttf5By-kRGp8bBuszw2CVksEqFgbrXjC5g18Fa_CYiD-2_Mre2UpYuLPJW4f8E4AnW487xIj8wIKVt8MS_5NyY7B2xfirhRhDnWamxOu0IX7Q6D-73gb-BQAA__8h8Y7I) about Brigitte Macron's identity and the couple's relationship through podcasts and social media posts, including claims that she was born male. It comes after a Delaware judge [dismissed Owens personally from the couple's earlier lawsuit](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGSozAQheHTQCYKNTKIQMEmzrzphlRbauzeEcJFN1Bz-6nxHGEu8F59_7_bdEPOXB5_caGgOk-FTsmkStu0YNzWIjvJelIR0f97ogcfPEELvbHW2HbCqHzQ5LBO4Q52RBdrCnYYXdf6Ecb6GXq4pNFD5xD9OEPq3KWPNvpu8HGG3tccvgetta21rXe-6ecOok1-SJ6iQ1e5lhLrujX6JKVSSIRozp_rQVsT16XO4an6kqr7U8G1gut5ng3flReSJq7N_lHBNWJJGMm8NSaxLCxCyfw4TaIZF1Rei8l4ys5qrAffOV9vIb1OzpmlHyrXPhbk_L7VXzY7AnwFAAD__6Negsk) there, after she argued the state lacked jurisdiction because she lives in Tennessee, though claims against two of her companies continue. Owens has defended her reporting and called the Delaware case an extreme overreach by a foreign leader.
## Court Rules for Religious Charter School
A federal judge has [ruled that Tennessee can't require charter schools to be nonreligious](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAURL8GdxouTassWMzGXc92loaGizJB6MBVMn8_8SXvC962qlKVOn9e68uEGNL22xyoifyasNWIRFjWw9iSUz2x5oapVvp7OtzCFVbBxdgD9MBXYylcuErTOf0WoIy0HWqYlHzwWQnV7XqUHPjbqXlU3gOCR-WsN5PgE38if3ZB34UAwAH4LOdh9A9hwc2Tm9FKI5nk6ALlMtCOhClhrYg-_ssXlsHmo4t6J_pU9vjFxMLE0lobmiG8TSaW-xUTC7rTGgo59dXuOcdbs_ks1JfzptAXjGEL-ay93U0hLN_BnhITS1e0-7QQY6jjxCTfDhPi1z79EN6lxf8AAAD__xuqh0o) to take part in the public program, finding the requirement unconstitutional and barring Knox County's school board from enforcing it. The case was brought by the Wilberforce Academy of Knoxville, a Christian nonprofit that [sued after the board wouldn't accept its application](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykULtu7CAU_BrcYcEx60dBcRt3e9uUFobjNQmGFRzb2b-PHGm_IM0UM9K8Pu7T3fjg4-O_2VATLVPEswQkwjxtxuYUy44lnRhLoc_d4cMffgIBLZeSSzEZS_7ASZnK6RnkYJStUMtuUI3oBxiqVXe9Qmtx6KRqzG02cplb0Q-Nc0I0OEDl9WUopRRSil71dbs0YKXrO9ejVUYxJdB5SrmmFQljxFIQl_BKB-bapq0KeiV6Ftb8YzAyGM_zrM8jUE0HgxEE3BiMEhiM4gK7Zl_Im8iLXVMK_FrJv2L65jbtkV5vfk4mO37FcLuaTJjfSt4Dlipr9zx9CL60HVPisRkffgvRH988NPwEAAD___3ri9w) unless it affirmed it would be nonsectarian. Attorney General Jonathan Skrmetti had [called the state's ban likely unconstitutional](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL0SmzAQhJ9GdDCSkPkpVKShc9qUzHE6QLaQPNIBk7fPOEVeIN02u_vN9-s5P8EHH7efcJBlXudIdwnETHk-AHOK5aSSboql8Ot0tPnLz1rqrlaqVnIGZH_RbKBydtFqBIMVWdWPppXDqMdqtwtg_8DRaYlqWB-uR3TdiMNDurVFs1TefgeVUlIpOZih6dZWo3JD7wZCA0YYSc5zyg3vxBQjlUK0ht_potxgOqpgd-ZPEe0PoSehp_u-G9whvBcCblLehJ7-FYWevodCT1J_cy_0lCn4zaez1LhDZsp1wT2lUAe4y-m5fqUIvEOsyzsfxOyrbN3n9iH40vXCyO0AH_7C8H-avKz-EwAA___L_YsY) and declined to defend it, leaving the Knox County board to argue the case on its own. Opponents, including a group of public school parents and faith leaders, argue that taxpayer-funded religious charter schools blur the line between church and state.
## In-Laws Tie for Parrottsville Seat
Cocke County [certified a tie](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkbGuozAQRb8GOke2McEUFNvQvW23RMN4SGbX2BGeYL2_X5FfeN2Rru6Vju6fr-ULOHJ6_IadJpFtSVRLJBE6lh3wyKm8qeRKqRT5-w704JMXq-1dGaOMXgCFT1octGFarRnBYUuTGUbXaT_asX1OvQEk8B2sWw-m9x2SGfQ4kMH-HiC0PF2DxhhtjPbO3-5bZ9EEPwRP6MA1TlNgycdNniSUEpVCtMXvfNJxw7y3cXqKvErT_Wrs3Ni51nqrK3_Cxs5wCGOkxs6XX2PnV44sjBdSJBTO6WLM-I8U5neSb4V0CG9MRQmTWkkqUVKcVIRa1MYJonrBcWSRcnKMV3HfuRTOSRUCaezcG4WBts4OVmnqUblApLxdvep6bWAgvzrft8cUXpVj5HIfGqcfO3D8iMkPXzkn-z8AAP__DN6krg) for the final seat on Parrottsville's town commission, with Mayor Gayla Ann Hommel and Commissioner Ronnie Hommel, who are in-laws, each receiving 38 votes. The town commission will now decide how to break the tie. Whichever way the commission decides, a member of the Hommel family will hold the seat. Parrottsville is a [small town in Cocke County](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0L9OwzAQgPGncbZGOcfkz-ABIWUrYkBijK72JT1w7Mq-JuLtUZF4AsZv-Q3fx3k-IweO6ytuZEWWOdJRAolQnjd0OcVyp5IOiqXI593TyjvPutHdCeAEzYxOeKfZYOXtRcOIxlVkoR9N2wyjHqur1Rc3LgP2QPRkTK8HQvQOW-fAw9JBxfYBAkAD0AxmqLul1Q780PuBnEGjTEOeJeVariQUI5VCtITvtFOuXdqqYK8it6LaZ6UnpSeK9cFffCPPWKe8Kj09WunpDXNOImXnEEjpl_n9z6uy9beDQ-DS9co064YcfnX555rd6p8AAAD__3Anezs), where a handful of ballots can decide a local race.

## Dulles Opens New Concourse E
Washington Dulles International Airport opens its new 14-gate Concourse E to passengers today. It’s the airport’s [first new concourse in nearly 20 years](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO3CAQhU-DO1YMy9qmoEjj7k-b0po1g43EggVjW7l95ETJBVLP6L3vez--5i-MKeb1O37I8RnmTFdLxEx19kdK1DJdS8lLOWqjVE6qLc1a6V4CSFAzLhxPmg123gU0hLYjB4M1T2Whh25zVtn-BUa9Xx6eFELox9GiCjiiGkktXXR3HgAoANBP-xjeL-2NDz34waphFEaRj1zqgzc6Y11jjhjSz5vmsZRPl9zGvDfx_Cb0JPR0cdnvg9DT33ehp7tF6AlA6OmPm8RY91JZcpFHPikmmemS_3zlFXmTYOSKTE1WaoxHxcxNYvZyx9Yor1RlKkdeSeipq87vV0wptn4QRq0fjOk3I__nvKfTvwIAAP__oaSR-Q). The 435,000-square-foot addition was built for United Airlines and connects directly to the AeroTrain, with jet bridges at every gate, nearly 20 new shops and restaurants, and a nearly 40,000-square-foot United Club, the airline’s second-largest lounge. United and the Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority [previewed it](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd0SAMTaFi23cvW23tMbMkCARiIAYvb9f-UXaH9h25uro3vPna_-CEEO6_4Ynre30e6JeI7VGZcd3jFQTdZeTy-9SKeaTSo27EspwKbkUO7gWTto1DLh60AR2oFXOVo_CSiOHx2qdIbMIMyFMRo8KNerJz3ZZ8DjQuCGsF09KKaSUarS3-ZiulDcSZyvmhWlBGFout_agM5R7SAF8_L7a3Fx-DnF9tPaqbPzF1MbU1nu_9XcFe32Z2s6AlJnarnFMbTE7iD_nD4qp7bOVQyivXBrPL0qV-1Bq44k6_2eAh8SV4N8E5SKZiR8jSnTHxNEBcW2M44cDwcHjdFj0TuIylBVfPcQYqpmZFvcnhPjTvP2n9HNVfwMAAP___cuX1Q) before the opening. Concourse E is the first piece of a [much larger modernization plan](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu8yAUBeCnsbdY3ItjzMDwS7-ypWtHhOGSIBGwgJj27Sv3FbqeI306Op93fTchhvT4MC9S7fA6Ua-RWqOi3TtGqom6zcnmd6kU80GlRo0MlwvABZg2toWD9GxGp7yZyciRFAg5cyZhgfGptitePV8RYcONhLWbZWZd5SKNIAtiDOr0AIABAHI5ie2KbnZ-ASckE-swM3Kh5TK1Jx2hPEIKxsfvc81k82uM6tnaXgf-b8DbgLfe--T9V8r9rM-M3_aB_-cLipWNRbm9hxhDXcQws8fLhPjrtD9ecCj8CQAA__8FgW_C) that will eventually add dozens of gates and retire the mobile lounges that have shuttled Dulles passengers since 1962. ## Virginia Challenges Proposed Census Rule
Virginia has joined 23 other attorneys general and two governors in formally opposing a Trump administration proposal [_to count only U.S. citizens_](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO3CAQhJ8Gd5xY7N8-Coo07i5tSmsDa5sIg8WCT_f2kSPlCf7-m5lP8-u1vDDEkLafeJCt17okenOkWqksvsVInOjtcnK5FaaYLyocF630KAEkqAVdDRctA3berjgQmo4sTGbolYERut0-zeg14Nc4KYPa96onr5Ui1T8Hhc-1C_buAwAFALo3j-n3l_aDX0fwk1HTUwyKfKi5POpOVyhbSAHX-LltHi4fXbR7rSeL_ofQs9Dzf-ag4lr53IzQ870i9Awg9KzMjaF0uUUvY2aShc5CTKliDTnJtSUf0iZb8lTkWfKZmbx0lLixLC2SdDumjSRu8k9OxHLPje9ILhtLxo_Qc1esP98hxsDjJAa1HRjiP-f6zbsvq_8GAAD__1VXl2k) and lawful permanent residents in the next census. The U.S. Census Bureau’s [proposed rule](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkbGunTAMhp8mbEFxyCUwMHRhu107Ip_EcCyFBCUB1LevqM7Qvetn67N__b--l2_kwHH7iTtN9VqXSHcJVCvlxZ8hUIl0uxRdOnOhkC7KJSxa6V4CSFALusoXLQYbP61oCMeGJrCj6dQIPTTvyTk1DLbvDH758aVfL70a9Nas1pIxXd_w9PgAQAGA7sbWvr60N37twdtR2UEYRZ5rym1908V548i4ht_PN61LexOmd61HEd0PoWeh5_u-25U8ZQyZNi6VcrulS-jZJ3fuFGsRen6uCj2rUegZ1AdIGMwAzyY5ipExSEexnEWmVdY3ySMdZ8DKKT4Ed8rsMBZ55HSkQl5mKuwpOpIuc6XMKDH6f-fbR1CaPPnj5hC49FYYte3I4W-i-p9lXJP-EwAA__9hzaHO) would also change how a person’s “usual residence” is defined and end the collection of race and ethnicity data. Trump directed the change last year, arguing a count that excludes people in the country illegally would make congressional apportionment more accurate. Attorney General Jay Jones, [_who announced Virginia’s participation_](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unTAQhJ8GOiOv-S8o0pzupk2J9uK1ceRjI-8COm8fkVe49Ugz33x_vtYvDDEk_xvftMjl1kQ3RxKhstozRuJE95bTls_CFPNFheNqtBkUgAK94ibhorXD2i4OO8K5pgXGuWv1DAPU-zJ9990GU-ucM_1AMJmeoKNJ0wDDOOg6LE8fAGgAMO3cjN-9sZ11A9hx1uNUdZpskFwa2ekKxYcU0MXPQ9Ns-V3HZRc5uGp_VeZVmdd9301G37CgUHNhc3JlXm-yAdVGSahU5vU8VYUiIdMTt9BrhSK5JPooT4kKRvU3J2Llgt-FFXoMiUUdJR-ZyaozRbzdGdW2Y_LESrIyutXPCp9cl8Ued4gx8DBWnfZvDPE_sfxQ9rWYfwEAAP__8CaXbQ) Nov. 4, called the proposal “Trump’s effort to rig the board,” warning that excluding noncitizens could cost Virginia congressional seats and federal money for housing, schools, and health care. The public comment period drew nearly 150,000 responses before closing Nov. 2. The administration could revise or advance the rule. Census Day is April 1, 2030.

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1975, the freighter _SS Edmund Fitzgerald_ sank in Lake Superior during a massive storm, killing all 29 crew members. The singer Gordon Lightfoot memorialized the tragedy in [a hit song the following year](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUxvGnwVssDseQy8AQ6SpbOrRVOyIMxzERMZZNsPz2lfsKXb9P-g3_75u9uZjidH9zTzJlyHaibU1UCi12qjFEt877vOSefE6J7jQnt1vBhToBnIBb50usZKEJZiAShA0ZOOsOgSPIZjRaeC86KXvU1NM_QhUwoNbkkaPy2ERzcADAARCkbP0wqF6i7GTwAhFYxynEkpf2keNURhrSnistrc_PJpmxlHlleGHiysR127Z2z6_y6un4j8UVPzK8Vob_df34VOPX-0NcmsWEeYspxVWdWcfvTxfTL1n-FqIa8RMAAP__EntxsA). Have you ever wanted to be an astronaut? NASA is taking applications, and this class will help build a base on the moon. The pay is $164,000, the training takes two years, and the [commute is about 239,000 miles](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdD55bTjuChdp6C5tSrRnFtjE2JbtcOLvIyLlC9KN9EZPo_l4jA9kz2F5x41sneMY6FU81Up5DDtPjCUdKccnueg9LZQ8HqNW-ioBJKgRXeWdRmgmOxNpMg1Z6O-tAWWga1brZoc3dXfQtnQjREO97p-tc4oQbq5v2J46AFAABrru4ub5-uxM13aT08aAaBVNXGO-fEYOdaXZH3GnfHFxa7xda01FmDehB6GHcKRY6omEHk6x0AOA0IO6Cz0UxxQcnT0sKLnIlTOHRWJJf6HmGPC7Fvli7-Ur5i8Zg6wryS3GIPTQZDulE3K59qJVy4bsf8fU_124W_0TAAD__zSJhkU). We have the details below, plus a poll asking whether you would go. Could eating more carbs actually help you age slower? Bread, pasta, and potatoes have spent decades on diet culture's blacklist, blamed for everything from blood sugar spikes to expanding waistlines. But researchers who tracked 20 blood markers in adults ages 65 to 75 found something surprising. After just four weeks on a certain diet, one group's biological clock had run back more than a year. So, what carbs can you embrace and which ones should you avoid? Ayla has the full story on today's episode of _The Flyover Podcast_. ## Nvidia CEO Admits Affair Amid Spy Probe
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang [admitted Sunday he was unfaithful](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOozAURb8GOkd-NoakcLFNumy7JTLmGV70YlvGELFfP8rMJ0x9patzzr_H-HDEFJe_7oW2hjRGfG-MtWIZ40EzuS2fuaQJfWLGBTO7c1RS9QJAgBydr3TgCO1sA6JC3aKF4dZpkBpMu9rbMHljFIb-OvRdMBqcC7438qplj-7akv3cAYAE0GDMxYfQT0abzsxeaQ1NJ3GmmsrlmSjWFQOf6cBy8enVsl1rzVuj_zTq3qh7xpQZP1Oj7j8G4olxwyjW3cVF5H1i8nwKlxOnhf7jJmoSbwooOBUSIRUxIcVF7DE4qmvYWYBSXXeTpi12zm9ipq0fmk4uL0f8DVJ_l--w6isAAP__3I-GKw) to Lori, his wife of more than 40 years, as the giant computer-chip company opened an investigation into whether he was the target of a Chinese intelligence operation. U.S. officials reportedly believe Huang was ensnared by Huang Le, also known as Alice Huang, a former Chinese state TV reporter linked to a Singapore firm that was [Southeast Asia's largest buyer](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuunDAQQL_GdLPymFcoKNLQ3bQp0WAGmMhrI8bsir-P2Ej5gdvO40jn_P4av0iCxPUXPbnPSxojvzVwznyM8SWzkO7XfqSJfQqBV94DXaOzrgFEQDuSz_LiEYu5X5gdlwX32HZVibbEutj6bmrIcTu37dJ5rKqqaYgqO1nH9KPzXEh_4xDRIpZY1w-_LM1Ul3VVz96VJZrK8iw5HY8_SWLeeAlXevHx8OlZhH7LeVdT_jRuMG6I15403yvjhhts3IBo3GA744bpVImsatxAH50Z_HZPGHS_gIJ4hu2kuMKUSDPPQFM6M_xrAST3_Q7kPasCKZwKaVnECwWF9eA3-BQ9H_H_qz7Pdb0bGzcURz_vbwlBtGlNZdcnSfh45O_Vf_XubwAAAP__ZjSb4w) of Nvidia chips. Chinese officials dismissed the allegations as "slander." _" There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry,"_ Huang wrote in a memo to employees. President Trump called him an "[honorable guy](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuhDAURE9jOiN_20AoXKSh27QpkbE_8FfGRuCFcPuIzRHSzWikGb35fvQPS4Hi9GUXNHlMfcRzD5gzbn08yJPd12vd0oAuhYATrsFevRSy5gAcRG9dpgN7KLwZESWqAg00rVYgFFTFbBqUH76VQjvdDuAcNt63qAYxgHYDYkHmrgMAAaCgqko3jvVQqUpX3kmlgGmBnnLaymeimGccw5UO3EqXliKYOed1Z-qTyY7J7jzPckw_N8adM9kFOpDfnsnO0lvxPzT-xLhj5PPLxonn7bWsN5VouayLzfj1pBBorxumxbRYCu_F_L-fDiN_AwAA__967H3D)." Huang stays in charge during the review. Nvidia shares fell over 4% Monday, and analysts say the company has [no obvious successor](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OpTAQBODTmMzI3ebnETjYhOxtuiEy0IZeGcxAPxC3H6E5wsSfVKWqf-_u7TnyOv31CzkJqVvpOiKJ0N6tJ4_sj-3e9tTTkGKkibbo7w4NVhpAg-n8IHxSB9noAhGSzchB3RQWjIUym11jPFiPBZq-aYz11YugxkD4smYcjcnYPXEAYAAslGU-hFD1pS2LchzQWlCFoZEl7fn_xKvMFOKdTtrzIS1ZdLPIdij7R2GrsL2uK382_LDC9pC03wpb2zRVXStsZ9KLv3VPev4sftX09eHTR1pFp6AlJd3zpCXp4Dnmsywx2924XRwjH1WtCjMtjzzt8rvPToffAQAA__-6NoCO) to the man who built it, raising questions of whether Nvidia has become too big to be allowed to fail.
## NASA Opens $10B Moon Base Contracts
NASA said Saturday that SpaceX, Blue Origin, and six other companies can compete for up to [$10 billion in cargo deliveries](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb8Gull5bGDfK1ykodu0KZGxxzCRsZFtYPfvI5JPSH90de759ZpehgPH5afZSFefpkhXCVQr5Sme7NiU_bPnNJNNIdBCezCfSQo5ACKgmIytfNKErdOeSJJqSePzu1MoFPbtqpX7om9lxdAZ_3TYCWE677_U8ETpBoUt63sOEQWiwr5_WO-HuVd91zsrlcKmE-S4pvz4nTjWlXz4pJPyw6atDXqtdS-N-tHIsZHjdV0Pn97zUThSKTfTyNGnN9zPwHCGshtLjRyjKQaOeBKHAihm2FKKMJtCYFOs2dj6j33DHA6ClHnhCLcEhCOaDEsKDvJR1jZrt18cApfh2XRi2QyHv371_6qeWv4JAAD__2lPj00) to the moon as the agency works toward a permanent base at the lunar south pole by 2032. The agency also awarded Blue Origin $94 million, with an additional $140 million option, to land a [nuclear-powered rover](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQhZ8Guon8gxNSUGxDd7fdEg32kMzKeCzbgc3br3Jf4XZHOtL5-f58LV_IkdPjN-40tU2WRGeN1BqVJR0cGGt-5yIreYmRHpQjvhejzBW0Bq0W9I0PWnQfpo3IkO1p0rf7YLWy2vXPaVxxUE4NZhv9dXSDuq830jd3N6M1dxx7nj5xWmultdXOXfy2XVdn3eCCN9bqblAUuEm5_BVO7UlbfMtB5eJl7-P0bC3Xzv7qzNyZ-TzPS83o6eN2Zv7WQP9ylIKNJXVmxtJo59qZOWFFeKWDOFZ41aAVrBwjSwJOsIskWLESeEmtoG8VEp0QXwkL7FwrS6qAKUB7EuQiO1cC2QAhvXwkLJDlpEIBymdxX6aQz09Bvd66QT125Ph9o_0M_jGZ_wEAAP__8hKdng) built from spare Mars rover parts, which will launch in late 2028 to drill for water ice at the pole. _" When our astronauts return to the Moon, they will arrive with the first elements of the Moon Base already waiting for them on the surface,"_ NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman [said in a statement](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAURp9GOwwX0PEvKLaxm223NFe4KhPkGiAa334z-wpbfs2Xc86f9_zGEEPafuNBtq48J7pLpFopz-kKPmA5nzPzQo5jpI3OiM-spBoEgAA5o6vhohlab1ciRbolC68fo0Fq6NvduhFwMR7lzziOvXKgxpHo5eRqBgPetMF-7wBAAmjo-86t67D0uje9d0praIwkHyrn7sMh1Z3W-PBFuXN8tNHutZ6l0b8aNTVquu-7S1iw2_hq1PTVEZkiYaHvxIICb8y-iIM5iQULiZoxlZNzxRo4iUpuTxx5e0RxgZIjcWb-kKulUVObrT_vEGMow6sxcjswxH8o9f8CXlb9DQAA__9Ps4gg). The $10 billion is a ceiling for future orders, not money already spent. NASA is also hiring astronauts for the base, at a [$164,395 salary](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdD55bTjuChdp6C5tSrRnFtjE2JbtcOLvIyLlC9KN9EZPo_l4jA9kz2F5x41sneMY6FU81Up5DDtPjCUdKccnueg9LZQ8HqNW-ioBJKgRXeWdRmgmOxNpMg1Z6O-tAWWga1brZoc3dXfQtnQjREO97p-tc4oQbq5v2J46AFAABrru4ub5-uxM13aT08aAaBVNXGO-fEYOdaXZH3GnfHFxa7xda01FmDehB6GHcKRY6omEHk6x0AOA0IO6Cz0UxxQcnT0sKLnIlTOHRWJJf6HmGPC7Fvli7-Ur5i8Zg6wryS3GIPTQZDulE3K59qJVy4bsf8fU_124W_0TAAD__zSJhkU), with applications open through Dec. 3.
## Forecast: US Still Tops in 2040
A new [projection of the world economy](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFyhCAQxvGn0U6HBfG0oEhz3aVN6XCw3G1mFQaIjm-fMa-Q-vvmV_y_HsvDEtP2-rQrmhrisuFRGGvFvGw7ebIlnSnHJ7rIjC9MbM9FCjl2AB2IxbpKOy7QehMQJaoWDdzmQYFQoNu3UTBNTy3m4FHrabY3hWEaxxmkxuDF1JK5OAAQAAq07l0I41MrPWjvpFLQDAI91Zj770hbfWPgM-6YexfXls271lQa9dHIeyPvx3H0O5Ufy84mqpap1Ot4TTGz79DFLa5nJ8UgGnlvs_HpIGYq460ZxGu1xH9y_V-P3cjfAAAA__9gpnS5) in 2040 has the United States still on top, with output near $53 trillion and China about $5 trillion behind, down from a gap of roughly $10.7 trillion today. The forecast, from London’s [Centre for Economics and Business Research](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uhDAQQOHTmI6Vxz_AFi7S0G3alMg2Y3aiASPjsOL2UfYKqZ_0Fe_rMT08MW3Lp1_R1ZSnDV8HY61Ypu2kmfyxX3vJAWNmxgV39tekpOpagBbk5GOlEydoZpcQFeoGHfR3o0FqsM3TDcnE0KMMvQ7SDlIrP_S9GYy8-xiHriH3xwGABNBg7S2m1AWrrbFzVFqDMBJnqrncvjNt9YmJr3xiucW8Nuyete6H0B9CjUKNEcM7CDW-cuG5xZi3vFJsGf3yg231gVGosSlu3l_ETEfXCyOX1RO_yfq_EadTvwEAAP__CNhyHQ), puts world GDP at $227 trillion by 2040, with the U.S., China, and India generating 51% of it. India climbs from fourth to third. Germany slips to fourth, the United Kingdom passes Japan for fifth, and Indonesia cracks the top 10. [See full rankings here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFyhCAQxvGn0U6HBfG0oEhz3aVN6XCw3G1mFQaIjm-fMa-Q-vvmV_y_HsvDEtP2-rQrmhrisuFRGGvFvGw7ebIlnSnHJ7rIjC9MbM9FCjl2AB2IxbpKOy7QehMQJaoWDdzmQYFQoNu3UTBNTy3m4FHrabY3hWEaxxmkxuDF1JK5OAAQAAq07l0I41MrPWjvpFLQDAI91Zj770hbfWPgM-6YexfXls271lQa9dHIeyPvx3H0O5Ufy84mqpap1Ot4TTGz79DFLa5nJ8UgGnlvs_HpIGYq460ZxGu1xH9y_V-P3cjfAAAA__9gpnS5).

Early Democratic bills would that help families pay private school tuition, expand Medicaid, and create a redistricting commission. Republicans filed proposals to ban crypto kiosks and keep certain minors off social media. Supreme Court Clears Big Bend Wall The Supreme Court on Monday ruled that the Trump administration can resume building border barriers and roads in Texas' Big Bend region, that froze construction while a lawsuit plays out. In an unsigned order, the justices said U.S. District Judge Kathleen Cardone likely lacked authority to block the work, since the 1996 border law . Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson dissented. Federal attorneys argued would funnel crossings and drug trafficking into Big Bend, where agents apprehended more than 89,000 people from 2021 to 2025. The halt was costing nearly $500,000 a day, a border official said. The challengers, an environmental group, a river guide, and a Ruidosa church group, say Big Bend has of any border sector. The Center for Biological Diversity warned that contractors can now "bulldoze pristine desert and dynamite canyon walls." Suspected Homicide on Galveston Cruise Ship The FBI is aboard the MSC Seascape , a cruise ship authorities ordered back to the Port of Galveston on Monday after a reported incident involving a guest. The victim was a woman, and the Galveston County medical examiner expects to . The FBI, working with the Coast Guard and port police, hasn't said how she died. A man was taken into custody, but no charges have been announced. Whether the FBI can take a cruise ship case depends on factors such as the victim's nationality and . The Seascape , flagged in Malta, can carry more than 5,800 passengers and about 1,600 crew. MSC Cruises said it is "cooperating fully with the investigation and providing support to those impacted." ## Pet Owners Offered Screwworm Tips
Veterinarians recommend pet owners [check their animals daily](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkD2unDAUhVcDnZF_wB4KF2noJm1KdLm-gBWDke1gZVb_NE-zg1ceHen8fH-e8xN88Of2Gw6yBV7rfFLNgUqhNF9UcCf8m1Nc_JnjWZKH4KDMkkvNhGCCz4DF3zT30DqrNI6mb8kKM_ZKDOMg2t061GIUCE6Tlvgw4mE018tiaAU-qr719p0nhOBC8aE3nRrXwWhQBldQ-FianpPzJaau7ATJv-IJa_gfb0odxqMNdi_lyo361cipkVOttYMFxfB2Gzm9PzVyChEhsI-4qWR2pXh7R2z75x2cSAwyy5io1pgOlghwp8w-jczFLbfJuqv6EHzWpun5doAP3yPKT_ndVn4FAAD__10ph94) after two dogs were among the five confirmed New World screwworm cases in Cochise and Graham counties. The fly lays eggs in open wounds, and its larvae feed on living tissue. Scottsdale veterinarian Josh Sosnow said no medication is yet approved to prevent infestation, and owners should check surgical incisions daily for unusual odors. Pets traveling to California or Florida now [need a veterinary health certificate](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQRp_GdEb-Ay-FizR0N21KNGuGxbrGRvYEa_fpI6K8QaY-OvPp_PpaviDEkF4_4UBH8NmWhK1GJMKynEh-R_9dS36GVHOiEiCuQIsSauRScikW8BQuXAx0q9Ojn6zp0Ek7GS2HaZDd7qRVRlictnF6AA5e37cKjcp4rcyjC-72SSmF1GIwttfTNtgRtPUbaP94MiNwDZRLTztCCZ-cYIvvfGHpfT666HaiszL9g6mZqbm11sNngyPE9w0wNd8fmJqlZGoW083sQPyfi59IPLeEpfKEuPLvlBuHZ_5NnApceCfisBEWXn3B1nI5uIeKlb9KbkzNXXHr2UKMoY6WGfE6IMS_4-h_u15O_QkAAP__dK6OIQ) showing they're screwworm-free, and California also requires an entry permit, so owners should call their vet early.
## State's Biggest Crop Brings the Green
Lettuce topped the list of Arizona's most valuable crops, bringing farmers about $1.2 billion in 2025, according to [an analysis](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOpDXNjgULq6hy7VXosVegnUGR_ZerOTpT_z63-BvRiON9I1m_tyXO4YYzsdvPMgyfrblpFoiMVNensRuJ_e35LSGs6STc8DokRcp5NgBdCAWdBxetGhsvVWjm4xuyYKZtIJhGqDd7ejNqiUB3DYt5DjitErUTkr0N6BNtMFePAAQoMSgTa-mbTAjKuM2VO62NlqQD5xyzzthDp904hbf6UW5d-loo92Zn6VRvxo5N3KutfZv3FO60kbO16ZGzv8uwczBRbqsT1S6b1z3yKl2Ryrc4Vkq5Q6kAFCTMP3OR2yz9c8aYgxlNI0WjwND_Crnn_72svJ_AAAA__9nLIMS) of U.S. Department of Agriculture data. Hay ranked second at $236.5 million, followed by pecans at $92.6 million, broccoli at $79.6 million, and spinach at $73.4 million. Altogether, Arizona farmers received $2.7 billion from crop sales, the analysis found. | |

Despite the hard work and dedication of countless candidates, advocates, and volunteers across Texas, **the results of the midterm election are disappointing.** The medical liberty victories TFVC has secured over the past five years represent more than a decade of tireless work. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 Pop Acta Media | Republican Task Force PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

America is currently in the midst of an attempt to do to us what our own foreign-policy machinery spent decades doing to others: delegitimize an elected government through manufactured crisis, mass mobilization, and elite pressure until it falls. That is not a metaphor. It is a description. The only way to stop it is awareness.
This will be a long piece. Stay with me -- we all need to understand what is happening in the shadows.
Start with the tapes. If you have not reviewed the archive @DataRepublican -- Jennica Pounds -- has posted, do so now: thousands of transcripts and hundreds of recordings, reportedly found on public Google Drive links where an AI note-taker archived coalition meetings reaching back to 2023. A candid note on authenticity: the recordings have not yet been independently authenticated by any third party. But Pete Marocco, the official who dismantled USAID for President Trump, has publicly vouched for them -- and the scale and internal consistency of the archive is precisely why Congress must investigate. Come back when you have listened.
That, friends, is what a color revolution sounds like.
**What Is a Color Revolution?**
The term describes the wave of often nonviolent protest movements and government changes across the post-Soviet states and the former Yugoslavia -- triggered chiefly by election results widely viewed as falsified, coordinated online, and powered by NGOs.
The United States was the engine. It ran through the congressionally funded **National Endowment for Democracy** and its grantees -- the **National Democratic Institute** , the **International Republican Institute** , **Freedom House** -- alongside **USAID** and the **Open Society** constellation. The results: the Bulldozer Revolution in Serbia (2000), the Rose Revolution in Georgia (2003), the Orange Revolution in Ukraine (2004-05), the Tulip Revolution in Kyrgyzstan (2005), the Cedar Revolution in Lebanon (2005), the attempted Jeans Revolution in Belarus (2006 -- it failed), and Ukraine's Revolution of Dignity (2013-14), with suspicions running through the Arab Spring.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4aba817f-b472-45cb-a513-5c19bec3e648?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The covert CIA is the contested part of this history; the documented paper trail runs through open funding -- USAID, NED, and allied foundations. That is the worse indictment. The machinery was never hidden. It was a career. Second: several targeted governments, including Viktor Yanukovych's, were elected by standards no more corrupt than our own 2020 election. (The Maidan's proximate trigger was his reversal of an EU pact, but the legitimacy-stripping machinery was identical.) These NGOs are devoted not to democracy but to "democracies we approve of."
**How the Machine Works**
Practitioner manuals and the academic literature converge on six lines of attack:
1\. **Funding**. U.S. money flows through NGOs to local partners, building parallel structures outside national control that coordinate and sustain protest capacity at a professional level.
2\. **Training**. Pyramidal "train the trainer" programs teach branding, parallel vote counting, erosion of institutional legitimacy, and above all nonviolent discipline -- the discipline that maximizes the activists' legitimacy.
3\. **Narrative and symbolism**. Government illegitimacy is repeated relentlessly through complicit media, with a unifying color or slogan -- Orange, "No Kings," "Resistance" -- until regime change feels like the only democratic outcome.
4\. **Electoral trigger**. "Independent" monitors, conveniently timed polling, and rapid amplification of irregularities convert a disputed vote into sustained street action. The doctrine is nominally nonviolent, but its strategists understand what the manuals call "political jiu-jitsu": an overreaction by the state creates martyrs, and martyrs convert sympathy into power. I call that the provocation-martyrdom strategy.
5\. **Elite pressure**. High-legitimacy outsiders isolate the government, sanction it, and quietly work military, bureaucratic, and business elites until cooperating with the old regime costs more than accommodating the street.
6\. **Defection of security forces**. The whole apparatus aims here: convince soldiers and police they serve an illegitimate regime, then force the choice between firing on countrymen or defecting. When security forces defect, the revolution is over -- and it wins.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6d162db2-5ce5-4d14-b776-9ac411f14483?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Our American Color Revolution**
Now watch the same lines operate here in 2026, according to the materials Pounds has released and the public record around them.
Funding. The coalitions in the tapes -- the United Democracy Alliance (not AIPAC's United Democracy Project and not the Democracy Alliance donor club; the names are built to be confused), Renew to Thrive, 50501, Indivisible, and others -- are superbly resourced, much of it traceable to the Soros network and to the personnel and pipelines left behind when USAID was dismantled. The materials put Indivisible's training draw at as much as $7.6 million in Open Society money. Foreign money? Money laundering is a thing. Subpoenas answer this.
Training. Since 2020 the left has built exactly the pyramidal programs the doctrine prescribes. Indivisible's "One Million Rising" trains activists to map the Trump administration's "pillars of support" -- business, labor, faith, civil service, law enforcement -- and weaken them: sheriffs pressured not to cooperate with ICE, "Signs of Solidarity" campaigns against businesses, "Let's stop Trump." Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal's "Resistance Labs" has trained 32,000 people in all 50 states, its curriculum developed, by her account, with the Nonviolent Action Lab at Harvard's Kennedy School -- the shop of Erica Chenoweth, whose "3.5% rule" (no regime survives sustained participation by 3.5% of the population) is the movement's arithmetic of hope.
Underneath it all sits Gene Sharp -- the source code. Everyone in this field cites him as the mentor. Where did Sharp operate? Harvard's Center for International Affairs, the Cold War think tank insiders nicknamed "the CIA at Harvard," where his research was funded by the Department of Defense. His institution denies CIA money; the documented engine was the Pentagon's. The toolkit is real, and it came home.
Narrative and symbolism. Legacy media cannot type the words "election integrity" without appending "baseless." And when the Washington Post published its warmly framed, anonymously sourced profile of this same network in recent days -- no coup talk, just patriotic public servants protecting "our democracy" -- it demonstrated the third line's domestic expression: narrative conditioning, run through the most respectable channel available. "No Kings" supplies the color; "the Resistance" the brand.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c0a4bb8d-11b0-4c34-8c46-d66c864df108?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Electoral trigger. In the recordings, the talk turns to the midterms as the trigger. Here the doctrine's most delicate point must be stated with precision. When federal agents killed Renee Good and Alex Pretti in Minneapolis this past January, the movement did not need to manufacture martyrs; it received them. The jiu-jitsu dynamic -- sympathy converting into power through state overreaction -- operates whether or not anyone planned it. Whether anyone in those rooms *did* plan for such events is exactly what the verbatim recordings and a real investigation must establish. What is beyond dispute is that the dynamic did its work.
Elite pressure. The materials describe post-midterm scenarios in which mass protest pressures the administration toward invoking the Insurrection Act, with Democratic governors positioned as the legitimate alternative authority. Note carefully what is and is not on the tapes: scenario language is not operational orders -- yet. That distinction is precisely why the investigation matters. If the verbatim shows coordination of unlawful acts, this is not organizing. It is conspiracy.
Defection of security forces. In November 2025, six Democratic lawmakers -- veterans and intelligence alumni -- recorded a video urging service members to refuse "illegal orders." Conservatives named them the "Seditious Six"; the FBI sought interviews; no charges have followed. Whatever the intent, the function is unmistakable: seeding the idea that the military's loyalty belongs to individual conscience rather than the Commander-in-Chief. Add the passive resistance of the Senior Executive Service, and the sixth line is already lit. The plotters' fatal miscalculation is that our ranks are filled with patriots.
**The Objection You Must Answer**
The toolkit: it is regime-neutral. Indivisible's founders modeled their guide on Tea Party tactics; Venezuela's opposition used these same Sharp-derived methods with the blessing of governments we support. The issue was never the methods. The issue is who is coordinating them here, on whose money, aimed at what -- and only subpoena power answers that. That is the demand.
**What You Can Do**
1\. Pray.
2\. Call your congressman and senators. Demand an investigation of the DataRepublican materials. Light up the switchboards. Make them pay attention.
3\. Tell everyone you know. The time is past caring whether Cousin Susie will cut you off. Make them listen to the audio, if nothing else. Our nation and our freedoms are at risk.
This modern American Gunpowder Plot cannot and will not succeed -- not because the plotters lack skill, but because awareness arrived in time. The people in those rooms were trained for sleepy publics.
They got ours.

It ran through the congressionally funded National Endowment for Democracy and its grantees -- the National Democratic Institute , the International Republican Institute , Freedom House -- alongside USAID and the Open Society constellation. The results: the Bulldozer Revolution in Serbia (2000), the Rose Revolution in Georgia (2003), the Orange Revolution in Ukraine (2004-05), the Tulip Revolution in Kyrgyzstan (2005), the Cedar Revolution in Lebanon (2005), the attempted Jeans Revolution in Belarus (2006 -- it failed), and Ukraine's Revolution of Dignity (2013-14), with suspicions running through the Arab Spring. | | ---|---|--- The covert CIA is the contested part of this history; the documented paper trail runs through open funding -- USAID, NED, and allied foundations. That is the worse indictment. The machinery was never hidden. It was a career. Second: several targeted governments, including Viktor Yanukovych's, were elected by standards no more corrupt than our own 2020 election. (The Maidan's proximate trigger was his reversal of an EU pact, but the legitimacy-stripping machinery was identical.) These NGOs are devoted not to democracy but to "democracies we approve of." How the Machine Works Practitioner manuals and the academic literature converge on six lines of attack: 1\. Funding. U.S. money flows through NGOs to local partners, building parallel structures outside national control that coordinate and sustain protest capacity at a professional level. 2\. Training. Pyramidal "train the trainer" programs teach branding, parallel vote counting, erosion of institutional legitimacy, and above all nonviolent discipline -- the discipline that maximizes the activists' legitimacy. 3\. Narrative and symbolism. Government illegitimacy is repeated relentlessly through complicit media, with a unifying color or slogan -- Orange, "No Kings," "Resistance" -- until regime change feels like the only democratic outcome. 4\. Electoral trigger. "Independent" monitors, conveniently timed polling, and rapid amplification of irregularities convert a disputed vote into sustained street action. The doctrine is nominally nonviolent, but its strategists understand what the manuals call "political jiu-jitsu": an overreaction by the state creates martyrs, and martyrs convert sympathy into power. I call that the provocation-martyrdom strategy. 5\. Elite pressure. High-legitimacy outsiders isolate the government, sanction it, and quietly work military, bureaucratic, and business elites until cooperating with the old regime costs more than accommodating the street. 6\. Defection of security forces. The whole apparatus aims here: convince soldiers and police they serve an illegitimate regime, then force the choice between firing on countrymen or defecting. When security forces defect, the revolution is over -- and it wins. | | ---|---|--- Our American Color Revolution Now watch the same lines operate here in 2026, according to the materials Pounds has released and the public record around them. Funding. The coalitions in the tapes -- the United Democracy Alliance (not AIPAC's United Democracy Project and not the Democracy Alliance donor club; the names are built to be confused), Renew to Thrive, 50501, Indivisible, and others -- are superbly resourced, much of it traceable to the Soros network and to the personnel and pipelines left behind when USAID was dismantled. The materials put Indivisible's training draw at as much as $7.6 million in Open Society money. Foreign money? Money laundering is a thing. Subpoenas answer this. Training. Since 2020 the left has built exactly the pyramidal programs the doctrine prescribes. Indivisible's "One Million Rising" trains activists to map the Trump administration's "pillars of support" -- business, labor, faith, civil service, law enforcement -- and weaken them: sheriffs pressured not to cooperate with ICE, "Signs of Solidarity" campaigns against businesses, "Let's stop Trump." Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal's "Resistance Labs" has trained 32,000 people in all 50 states, its curriculum developed, by her account, with the Nonviolent Action Lab at Harvard's Kennedy School -- the shop of Erica Chenoweth, whose "3.5% rule" (no regime survives sustained participation by 3.5% of the population) is the movement's arithmetic of hope. Underneath it all sits Gene Sharp -- the source code. Everyone in this field cites him as the mentor. Where did Sharp operate? Harvard's Center for International Affairs, the Cold War think tank insiders nicknamed "the CIA at Harvard," where his research was funded by the Department of Defense. His institution denies CIA money; the documented engine was the Pentagon's. The toolkit is real, and it came home. Narrative and symbolism. Legacy media cannot type the words "election integrity" without appending "baseless." And when the Washington Post published its warmly framed, anonymously sourced profile of this same network in recent days -- no coup talk, just patriotic public servants protecting "our democracy" -- it demonstrated the third line's domestic expression: narrative conditioning, run through the most respectable channel available. "No Kings" supplies the color; "the Resistance" the brand. | | ---|---|--- Electoral trigger. In the recordings, the talk turns to the midterms as the trigger. Here the doctrine's most delicate point must be stated with precision. When federal agents killed Renee Good and Alex Pretti in Minneapolis this past January, the movement did not need to manufacture martyrs; it received them. The jiu-jitsu dynamic -- sympathy converting into power through state overreaction -- operates whether or not anyone planned it. Whether anyone in those rooms did plan for such events is exactly what the verbatim recordings and a real investigation must establish. What is beyond dispute is that the dynamic did its work. Elite pressure. The materials describe post-midterm scenarios in which mass protest pressures the administration toward invoking the Insurrection Act, with Democratic governors positioned as the legitimate alternative authority. Note carefully what is and is not on the tapes: scenario language is not operational orders -- yet. That distinction is precisely why the investigation matters. If the verbatim shows coordination of unlawful acts, this is not organizing. It is conspiracy. Defection of security forces. In November 2025, six Democratic lawmakers -- veterans and intelligence alumni -- recorded a video urging service members to refuse "illegal orders." Conservatives named them the "Seditious Six"; the FBI sought interviews; no charges have followed. Whatever the intent, the function is unmistakable: seeding the idea that the military's loyalty belongs to individual conscience rather than the Commander-in-Chief. Add the passive resistance of the Senior Executive Service, and the sixth line is already lit. The plotters' fatal miscalculation is that our ranks are filled with patriots. The Objection You Must Answer The toolkit: it is regime-neutral. Indivisible's founders modeled their guide on Tea Party tactics; Venezuela's opposition used these same Sharp-derived methods with the blessing of governments we support. The issue was never the methods. The issue is who is coordinating them here, on whose money, aimed at what -- and only subpoena power answers that. That is the demand. What You Can Do 1\. Pray. 2\. Call your congressman and senators. Demand an investigation of the DataRepublican materials. Light up the switchboards. Make them pay attention. 3\. Tell everyone you know. The time is past caring whether Cousin Susie will cut you off. Make them listen to the audio, if nothing else. Our nation and our freedoms are at risk. This modern American Gunpowder Plot cannot and will not succeed -- not because the plotters lack skill, but because awareness arrived in time. The people in those rooms were trained for sleepy publics. They got ours. ? | | ---|---|--- You're currently a free subscriber to .
